title: data/actors/<id>.json
description: One actor's profile. Every value names the source that asserted it, and disagreements are kept as conflicts rather than resolved. Evidence-only sources never appear here.

name.description: The same display name as in actors/index.json.

aliases.description: Every published alias with the sources that assert it, display name included.

origin.description: Where each source says the actor operates from. Upper-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 where the source gives a code, otherwise the source's wording.

sponsor.description: The suspected state sponsor, per source.

malware.description: Malware and tools the sources link to the actor.

techniques_documented.description: Techniques ATT&CK documents for the actor.

techniques_reported.description: Techniques found in reports on this actor published within the trends window (the trailing 24 months, in whole quarters), with how many of those reports name each.

cves.description: CVEs named in any report on this actor, with their KEV status.

timeline.description: Dated reports per quarter, oldest first. Only quarters with at least one report appear, so the site fills the gaps. Undated reports are not counted.

reports.description: Every published report tagged with this actor, newest first and undated reports last. Empty for an actor with no reports.

conflicts.description: Fields on which published sources disagree.

evidence_count.description: Shared-alias evidence edges behind this actor's merge. Edges from evidence-only sources are counted here but never named.

cluster_only.description: True when the only thing behind this actor is a vendor's cluster ID in one of that vendor's post titles. No source lists the actor and no post ties the ID to a name.

aliasClaim.description: One alias and every published source that asserts it.

sourcedValue.description: One value and the source that asserts it.

claimedTargets.description: Countries and sectors the sources say the actor targets. These are actor-level claims, not facts about any one campaign.

malwareClaim.description: A malware family or tool and the source that links it to the actor.

kev.description: True when the CVE is in the CISA KEV catalogue.

ransomware.description: KEV's known-ransomware flag, or null when the CVE is not in KEV.

conflict.description: A field where published sources disagree. Every side is shown; none is picked.

field.description: The actor field the sources disagree on.

values.description: Every published value, each with its source.

actorId.description: An ATT&CK group ID such as G0007, or a lower-case ASCII slug for an actor ATT&CK does not track. The ID is also the actor's file name and URL segment, so it has no colons, slashes or spaces, and it is never 'index'.

cve.description: A CVE ID in upper case.

label.description: Non-empty text with no leading or trailing whitespace and no line breaks.

reportId.description: The report's SHA-1 in lower-case hex when one is known, otherwise <source>:<source_id>.

sourceKey.description: A connector key such as attack or misp, as listed in sources.json. Never a display name.

techniqueId.description: An ATT&CK technique or sub-technique ID.
